description: Elixir mix: Ecto drops, resets, and rollbacks, Hex publishing, archives, and build and test tasks.

rules.note: `ecto.drop` drops the database. `ecto.reset` drops and creates it again. `ecto.rollback` reverts migrations.
`hex.publish` publishes a package. `hex.retire` marks a release as retired.
`archive.install` and `escript.install` install code from outside the project.

safe.note: Tests, compilation, formatting, static checks, dependencies from mix.lock, migration listings, routes, and the local server.
